input.userInput: Fix UI bug: Cannot blacklist boxes from mixins. When trying to hide 'Master Node 1' or 'VM 1' from ext_layers.yaml, other IDs are being considered as blacklisted ('id_1_1', 'id_1_2'). Quick fix approach: Improve the ID extraction logic in getBoxPrefix() function (main.js:4077).

requirements.text: Fix getBoxPrefix() logic to correctly parse hierarchical box IDs (e.g., 'id_1_l1_1' from SVG element ID 'id_1_l1_1_g')
Ensure blacklisting works correctly for boxes from mixins (Master Node 1, VM 1, etc.)
Minimize backend (Go) changes - focus on JavaScript/UI layer only

clarifications.question: Which approach to implement?
clarifications.answer: Quick fix only: Fix getBoxPrefix() logic in main.js:4077

clarifications.question: Backend changes scope?
clarifications.answer: Minimize backend changes - focus on JavaScript layer

assumptions: The getBoxPrefix() function at main.js:4077 is the root cause of ID extraction failure
SVG element IDs follow the pattern 'id_<hierarchy>_<suffix>' where suffix is typically 'g' for group elements
The current function incorrectly strips non-numeric segments after the first numeric segment
Similar ID extraction issues may exist in related code (e.g., expanded boxes collector) but only getBoxPrefix() will be fixed in this quick fix
The fix will involve updating the parsing logic to preserve hierarchical structure (e.g., preserve 'l1' segments)
The test scenario with Master/Worker nodes and VMs at the provided URL can be used for manual verification

plan.overview: Implement a quick fix to the getBoxPrefix() function in main.js to correctly extract hierarchical box IDs from SVG element IDs. The root cause is that the current implementation loses non-numeric segments in the hierarchy (e.g., 'id_1_l1_1' is incorrectly extracted as '1_1' from SVG element ID 'id_1_l1_1_g'). This fix will restore proper blacklisting functionality for boxes from mixins.

phases.name: Analysis & Understanding
phases.summary: Deep dive into the current getBoxPrefix() implementation and ID structure
phases.description: Examine the getBoxPrefix() function at main.js:4077 to understand the current parsing logic. Analyze SVG element ID structure generated by the rendering layer. Document the pattern of hierarchical IDs and identify why non-numeric segments are being lost. Map the relationship between SVG element IDs and expected box IDs used in the blacklist mechanism.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Current getBoxPrefix() implementation documented and root cause confirmed
SVG element ID patterns analyzed with concrete examples (id_1_l1_1_g, id_1_l2_3_g, etc.)
Edge cases and variations in ID formats identified

phases.name: Parsing Logic Design
phases.summary: Design the new getBoxPrefix() parsing algorithm
phases.description: Design a new parsing algorithm that correctly extracts the full hierarchical ID from SVG element IDs. The algorithm should: (1) remove the trailing suffix (typically 'g') from SVG element IDs, (2) preserve all segments including non-numeric ones (like 'l1'), (3) handle edge cases and variations in ID format. Document the algorithm with pseudocode and test cases.

acceptanceCriteria.text: New parsing algorithm designed and documented with pseudocode
Test cases defined for various ID formats (hierarchical, flat, with/without suffixes)
Edge cases identified and algorithm handles them correctly
Algorithm preserves backward compatibility with simple numeric IDs

phases.name: Implementation
phases.summary: Rewrite getBoxPrefix() function with corrected parsing logic
phases.description: Update the getBoxPrefix() function in main.js (line 4077 area) with the new parsing logic. Replace the current implementation that only extracts numeric segments with the new algorithm that preserves hierarchical structure. Ensure the fix is minimal and focused, changing only the ID extraction logic without affecting other functionality.

acceptanceCriteria.text: getBoxPrefix() function rewritten with new parsing logic
Function handles various SVG element ID formats without errors
Code changes are minimal and focused only on ID extraction
No unintended side effects on other ID extraction operations

phases.name: Verification & Validation
phases.summary: Verify the fix works correctly with the test scenario
phases.description: Manually test the fixed getBoxPrefix() function using the provided test scenario URL with Master/Worker nodes and VMs. Verify that blacklisting now works correctly for boxes from mixins. Test with the specific cases mentioned: hiding 'Master Node 1' and 'VM 1' should not incorrectly blacklist other IDs like 'id_1_1' or 'id_1_2'. Check that the fix resolves the reported issue without introducing new problems.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test scenario loads successfully with fixed code
Blacklisting 'Master Node 1' correctly hides only that box, not 'id_1_1' or 'id_1_2'
Blacklisting 'VM 1' works as expected without side effects
No regressions observed in other UI functionality
